LESSON: BEHAVIOUR IN THE WORSHIP

Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: PLACE OF
Topic 5.3: Behaviour in the WORSHIP

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Behaviour in the WORSHIP. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how respect to God • Learners are guided to sing like during church service?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate good behavior in Church to show respect to God
2. recite short memory verses from the bible on good behaviour for spiritual development.
3. appreciate the importance of good behaviour in church to promote love and harmony e) desire to have good manners in the church 187

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. demonstrate good behavior in Church to show respect to God
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate good behavior in Church to show respect to God. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. recite short memory verses from the bible on good behaviour for spiritual development.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recite short memory verses from the bible on good behaviour for spiritual development. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the importance of good behaviour in church to promote love and harmony e) desire to have good manners in the church 187
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of good behaviour in church to promote love and harmony e) desire to have good manners in the church 187. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”
